description:
Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LegoSets" name="Lego brick sets"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SortedContainers" name="Sorted containers"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LegoMachine">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Builder" name="Machine builder" processRef="Process_Builder"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Children" name="Group of children" processRef="Process_Children"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SetsToChildren" name="Give Lego sets"
                      sourceRef="Task_GiveSets" targetRef="Start_ReceiveSets"
                      messageRef="Message_LegoSets"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SortedToBuilder" name="Return sorted containers"
                      sourceRef="Task_ReturnSorted" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSorted"
                      messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Builder" name="Build a custom Lego machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Builder" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GiveSets" name="Give Lego sets to children" messageRef="Message_LegoSets"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSorted" name="Receive sorted containers" messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsAvailable" name="Parts remain in a container?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsMerge" name="Continue with parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent from sorted parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Test successful?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Redesign" name="Redesign subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreComponents" name="More subcomponents remain?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Assemble" name="Assemble subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Builder" name="Machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B1" sourceRef="Start_Builder" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B2" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B3" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_GiveSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B4" sourceRef="Task_GiveSets" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSorted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSorted" targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B6" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_PartsMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">partsRemainInContainer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B7" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noPartsRemainInContainer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B8" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_PartsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B9" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsMerge" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B10" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B11" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B12" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Gateway_MoreComponents">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B13" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_Redesign">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testUnsuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B14" sourceRef="Task_Redesign" targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B15" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreComponents" targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">moreSubcomponentsRemain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B16" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreComponents" targetRef="Task_Assemble">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noMoreSubcomponentsRemain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B17" sourceRef="Task_Assemble" targetRef="End_Builder"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Children" name="Sort Lego parts" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReceiveSets" name="Lego sets received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveSets" messageRef="Message_LegoSets"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReturnSorted" name="Return sorted containers" messageRef="Message_SortedContainers"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Children" name="Sorted containers returned"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_ReceiveSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="Task_ReturnSorted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_ReturnSorted" targetRef="End_Children"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
